name: Keeping model secrets and user privacy safe
gist: These papers defend against attacks that try to steal what models learned (membership inference, model extraction) and develop privacy-preserving training where individual data points stay protected.
explain: A trained machine learning model is a trove of valuable information. It has seen training data—potentially millions of documents, conversations, or medical records. It has learned patterns that encode insights about the world. Attackers want to steal this. They might try membership inference: querying the model to figure out whether a specific person's data was in the training set. They might try model extraction: asking the model many queries to reverse-engineer its weights and parameters. Or they might try data extraction: making the model repeat verbatim pieces of its training data. Meanwhile, privacy regulations like GDPR say that people have a right to know what data is held about them. If your data is in a training set, you might want it removed. This creates a tension: how do you train capable models on sensitive data without exposing individuals?

Why is this hard? Because machine learning works by absorbing training data into learned patterns. The model doesn't explicitly store 'this person's medical record,' but it has implicitly learned something from it, and that knowledge is woven through millions of parameters. You can't point to a specific neuron and say 'this one holds the secret.' And even if you could, removing it might break other things the model learned. Furthermore, privacy and utility are in tension: a model trained on more diverse, detailed data works better. A model trained with strict privacy guarantees (like differential privacy, which adds mathematical noise to guarantee privacy) usually works worse because the noise degrades signal. And attackers keep getting smarter: they might combine membership inference with auxiliary information to increase the odds of a successful extraction.

The papers in this area work on defense in multiple ways. Some develop privacy-preserving training algorithms that guarantee that learning from a person's data only slightly increases the chance that an attacker can detect their presence. Others study membership inference attacks and defenses: how can you make a model's behavior insensitive to whether one training example is included or excluded? Others focus on model extraction: can you detect when someone is systematically querying the model to steal it? Still others study data extraction and how to defend against it. A newer direction is unlearning: if a person asks you to remove their data from a trained model, can you surgically modify the model weights without retraining from scratch? These are inherently tricky problems because privacy and capability trade off.

papers.title: (Token-Level) \textbf{InfoRMIA}: Stronger Membership Inference and Privacy Assessment for LLMs
papers.contribution: InfoRMIA outperforms the state-of-the-art RMIA method while offering improved computational efficiency and enables pinpointing which tokens are memorized within generated outputs.

papers.title: Benchmarking Empirical Privacy Protection for Adaptations of Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Shows distribution shifts strongly influence practical privacy risk; LoRA achieves highest empirical protection for OOD data despite identical theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: Convergent Differential Privacy Analysis for General Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates tight theoretical foundation for privacy reliability in FL-DP and proves results losslessly convert to other DP frameworks like (ε,δ)-DP.

papers.title: Curation Leaks: Membership Inference Attacks against Data Curation for Machine Learning
papers.contribution: Reveals privacy risks in data curation previously overlooked; shows models trained on curated public data leak membership about private guidance data, requiring formal privacy guarantees in curation design.

papers.title: Federated Learning of Quantile Inference under Local Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: The method accommodates data heterogeneity with individual privacy budgets and constructs confidence intervals via self-normalization without estimating nuisance parameters.

papers.title: INO-SGD: Addressing Utility Imbalance under Individualized Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: INO-SGD is the first algorithm designed to address utility imbalance while satisfying individualized differential privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Membership Privacy Risks of Sharpness Aware Minimization
papers.contribution: Shows SAM is more prone to membership inference attacks than SGD despite lower test error, with theoretical proof that SAM's geometric mechanism reduces variance and guarantees higher membership leakage.

papers.title: Natural Identifiers for Privacy and Data Audits in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: NIDs enable post-hoc differential privacy auditing without retraining and allow dataset inference for any suspect dataset containing NIDs without needing a private non-member held-out dataset.

papers.title: On Optimal Hyperparameters for Differentially Private Deep Transfer Learning
papers.contribution: Identifies that single (C,B) settings across tasks lead to suboptimal performance; explains when performance drops occur between loose/tight privacy and plentiful/limited compute settings.

papers.title: Pisces: Cryptography-based Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Dual-Path Retrieval
papers.contribution: First practical cryptography-based RAG framework achieving retrieval accuracy within 1.87% of plaintext baselines while preserving privacy for dual-path retrieval.

papers.title: RESFL: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Responsible Federated Learning by Balancing Privacy, Fairness and Utility
papers.contribution: On autonomous driving (FACET/CARLA), RESFL achieves high mAP, reduces membership inference attack success by 37%, and reduces equality-of-opportunity gap by 17% relative to FedAvg.

papers.title: Rethinking LoRA for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning in Large Models
papers.contribution: Achieves SOTA on Swin Transformer and RoBERTa models with 16.83% improvement over RoLoRA on Swin-B under strict privacy budget.

papers.title: SHE-LoRA: Selective Homomorphic Encryption for Federated Tuning with Heterogeneous LoRA
papers.contribution: Performance comparable to non-private baselines with strong attack resistance, 99.71% reduction in communication overhead and 99.87% reduction in encryption time.

papers.title: Searching for Privacy Risks in LLM Agents via Simulation
papers.contribution: Discovers escalating attack tactics from direct requests to impersonation and consent forgery; defenses evolve from rules to robust identity-verification; strategies transfer across scenarios.

papers.title: $\texttt{FHAIM}$: Fully Homomorphic AIM for Private Tabular Synthetic Data Generation
papers.contribution: Preserves AIM performance while maintaining feasible runtimes on encrypted data with privacy protection.

papers.title: ACTG-ARL: Differentially Private Conditional Text Generation with RL-Boosted Control
papers.contribution: ACTG-ARL achieves 20% MAUVE improvement over prior work in DP synthetic text quality while providing fine-grained control and strong privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Accuracy-First Rényi Differential Privacy and Post-Processing Immunity
papers.contribution: The new definition ensures post-processing immunity while enabling practical applications like synthetic data generation and classifier fine-tuning with adaptive privacy bounds.

papers.title: Accurate, Private, Secure, Federated U-statistics with Higher Degree
papers.contribution: Substantially improves accuracy for private federated U-statistics computation, achieving up to four orders of magnitude MSE reduction over existing baselines for statistics like Kendall's τ coefficient.

papers.title: AlienLM: Alienization of Language for API-Boundary Privacy in Black-Box LLMs
papers.contribution: Retains over 81% of plaintext-oracle performance on average substantially outperforming baselines, recovering fewer than 0.22% of alienized tokens under adversaries with model weights access.

papers.title: An Empirical Study on the Resilience of Partial Merging to Model Clone Attacks
papers.contribution: Experiments reveal that merging NNs without adequate protection is highly vulnerable, with adversaries able to recover significant portions of private model performance even with limited exposure.

papers.title: Asymptotic Optimality of the High-Dimensional Gaussian Mechanism and Improved Low-Dimensional Mechanisms for Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: Establishes that no additive-noise mechanism can asymptotically improve on the Gaussian mechanism's privacy-utility tradeoff in high dimensions, and provides tight composition results for the new mechanism family.

papers.title: Back to Square Roots: An Optimal Bound on the Matrix Factorization Error for Multi-Epoch Differentially Private SGD
papers.contribution: BISR achieves asymptotically optimal error matching upper and lower bounds, with comparable empirical performance to SOTA while being simpler and more efficient.

papers.title: Beyond Membership: Limitations of Add/Remove Adjacency in Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: Empirical results demonstrate a critical gap between add/remove and substitute adjacency audit findings, highlighting that the choice of adjacency is essential when protecting per-record attributes.

papers.title: Black-Box Privacy Attacks on Shared Representations in Multitask Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrate efficient attacks on ML models that work across vision and language domains without requiring shadow models or labeled reference data.

papers.title: Censoring with Plausible Deniability: Asymmetric Local Privacy for Multi-Category CDF Estimation
papers.contribution: Avoids need to predefine sensitive region; provides theoretical guarantees including uniform consistency and pointwise weak convergence.

papers.title: Concept-Aware Privacy Mechanisms for Defending Embedding Inversion Attacks
papers.contribution: Consistently reduces privacy leakage across six datasets while achieving superior downstream performance compared to state-of-the-art DP methods.

papers.title: Contextualized Privacy Defense for LLM Agents
papers.contribution: CDI achieves 94.2% privacy preservation and 80.6% helpfulness with superior robustness to adversarial conditions compared to baseline defenses.

papers.title: Continual Learning With Participation Privacy: An Auditable Buffering-Aggregation Recipe
papers.contribution: Achieves trajectory-level (ε,δ)-DP for single-edit streams with explicit privacy-latency link via bin size U.

papers.title: Credibility-Aware Weighting Federated Causal Discovery for Time Series
papers.contribution: Fed-CAW recovers global causal graphs while preserving personalized local structures and demonstrating effectiveness on synthetic and real-world datasets.

papers.title: DP-Fusion: Token-Level Differentially Private Inference for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: DP-Fusion creates token-level provably privatized documents with improved privacy/utility trade-off, achieving 6× improvement in privacy guarantees.

papers.title: DP-KFC: Data-Free Preconditioning for Privacy-Preserving Deep Learning
papers.contribution: Propose DP-KFC achieving preconditioner estimates without private or public data, matching private-data baselines in privacy regimes.

papers.title: Decoupling Regularization and Privacy in Differentially Private Ridge Regression and ERM
papers.contribution: Derives explicit bias-variance-DP-variance risk decomposition; characterizes optimal (α,c) in several regimes; improves accuracy relative to single-parameter regularization.

papers.title: Differentially Private Cross-Silo Recommendation from Implicit Feedback
papers.contribution: Achieves better privacy-utility trade-off than state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets while maintaining formal privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Differentially Private Domain Discovery
papers.contribution: Extends known-domain algorithms to unknown-domain variants with new utility guarantees, demonstrating competitive or superior performance on all three problem types.

papers.title: Differentially Private Geodesic Regression
papers.contribution: Demonstrates methodology on spheres, symmetric positive definite matrices, and Kendall's planar shape space with privacy guarantees generalizable to any Riemannian manifold.

papers.title: Differentially Private Preference Data Synthesis for Large Language Model Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive alignment performance under strong differential privacy guarantees, demonstrating synthetic preference data as a practical privacy-preserving alternative.

papers.title: Differentially Private Range Subgraph Counting
papers.contribution: First efficient DPRSC algorithms with small additive error; proves lower bounds showing error must be exponential in dimension.

papers.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via APIs 4: Tabular Data
papers.contribution: Substantially outperform AIM baseline on high-order correlation datasets, improving classification accuracy by up to 10% while running 28× faster.

papers.title: Disrupting Hierarchical Reasoning: Adversarial Protection for Geographic Privacy in Multimodal Reasoning Models
papers.contribution: Achieves 14.4% improvement in tract-level protection (33.8% vs 19.4%) and nearly doubles block-level protection (33.5% vs 16.8%) across seven state-of-the-art MLRMs.

papers.title: Doxing via the Lens: Revealing Location-related Privacy Leakage on Multi-modal Large Reasoning Models
papers.contribution: Most advanced MLRMs/MLLMs outperform non-expert humans in geolocation inference, revealing that models leverage visual clues and internal world knowledge to infer private location without built-in suppression mechanisms.

papers.title: EPSVec: Efficient and Private Synthetic Data Generation via Dataset Vectors
papers.contribution: Outperforms baselines in distributional alignment and downstream utility particularly in low-data regimes while significantly reducing computational overhead; differential privacy preserved throughout.

papers.title: Efficient DP-SGD for LLMs with Randomized Clipping
papers.contribution: DP-SGD-RC matches baseline utility while significantly reducing memory and compute on long-context LLM fine-tuning tasks.

papers.title: Efficient privacy loss accounting for subsampling and random allocation
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that random allocation achieves at least as good privacy-utility trade-off as Poisson subsampling, with better suitability for DP-SGD training.

papers.title: Eliminating Solution Bias in Differentially Private Optimization
papers.contribution: Injects significantly less noise than DP-SGD under the same privacy level and converges to the optimum in strongly-convex case or diminishing neighborhood in non-convex case.

papers.title: Enhancing Membership Inference Attacks on Diffusion Models from a Frequency-Domain Perspective
papers.contribution: High-frequency filter significantly improves baseline attack performance across datasets and models with no additional computation.

papers.title: Exponential-Wrapped Mechanisms: Differential Privacy on Hadamard Manifolds Made Practical
papers.contribution: Achieves multiple DP notions on general Hadamard manifolds with superior utility and runtime on synthetic and real-world data.

papers.title: FIBER: A Differentially Private Optimizer with Filter-Aware Innovation Bias Correction
papers.contribution: Consistently demonstrates substantial improvements in DP optimizer performance across vision and language benchmarks, surpassing state-of-the-art results under equivalent privacy constraints.

papers.title: Fast and Near-Optimal Algorithms for Private Hypothesis Selection
papers.contribution: Achieves near-optimal statistical rates while running in nearly linear time in number of hypotheses under differential privacy constraints.

papers.title: FedMC: Federated Manifold Calibration
papers.contribution: FedMC consistently enhances performance of state-of-the-art FL algorithms across benchmarks by explicitly modeling nonlinear manifolds.

papers.title: Federated Learning with Profile Mapping under Distribution Shifts and Drifts
papers.contribution: Feroma achieves up to 12 percentage points accuracy gain over state-of-the-art methods across 6 benchmarks under dynamic data heterogeneity while maintaining FedAvg-comparable overhead.

papers.title: Federated Manifold Learning (FML): Tackling Domain Heterogeneity with Structural Knowledge Transfer
papers.contribution: Substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Digits and Office31 benchmarks with accuracy improvements up to 6.47%.

papers.title: Finding DoRI: Discovery of Retained Images in Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Findings enable more robust mitigation through adversarial fine-tuning and inform development of more reliable defenses against DM memorization.

papers.title: Fine-Grained Privacy Extraction from Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems by Exploiting Knowledge Asymmetry
papers.contribution: Achieves over 90% extraction accuracy in single-domain and 80% in multi-domain settings, outperforming baselines by over 30%.

papers.title: FlatLand: Personalized Graph Federated Learning via Tailored Lorentz Space
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on diverse federated graph learning tasks, particularly in low-dimensional settings.

papers.title: From Prompts to Responses: Dual-Sided Data Leakage and Defense in Split Large Language Models
papers.contribution: ADMI effectively defends against PIDI and state-of-the-art inversion attacks with minimal task performance impact.

papers.title: Gradient Inversion Attacks Beyond SGD
papers.contribution: The method enables stronger attacks on adaptive optimizers than traditional gradient-matching techniques and improves attacks in standard SGD.

papers.title: HiddenEcho: Mitigating Noise Amplification in Differentially Private LLMs with Hidden-State Correction
papers.contribution: HiddenEcho achieves up to 46.89% performance improvement over DP baselines, over 85% communication reduction, and up to 72.52% faster training compared to existing denoising approaches.

papers.title: Hot PATE: Private Aggregation of Distributions for Diverse Tasks
papers.contribution: Shows significant improvements in privacy-utility tradeoff on in-context learning tasks by preserving output diversity while maintaining privacy guarantees.

papers.title: How does Bayesian Sampling help Membership Inference Attacks?
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance in both effectiveness and efficiency across image, text, and tabular datasets with theoretical guarantees on variance reduction.

papers.title: Hubble: a Model Suite to Advance the Study of LLM Memorization
papers.contribution: Establishes memorization determined by data frequency relative to corpus size; identifies best practices of diluting data and early training insertion to reduce memorization.

papers.title: Improved Bounds for Private and Robust Alignment
papers.contribution: First theoretical results for private and robust online alignment, with improved bounds in the joint privacy-and-corruption setting.

papers.title: LAPRAS : Learning-Augmented PRivate Answering for linear query Streams.
papers.contribution: Achieves near-offline privacy utility when predictions overlap highly with actual queries and degrades gracefully when overlap is low.

papers.title: Learnability and Privacy Vulnerability are Entangled in a Few Critical Weights
papers.contribution: This mechanism enhances resilience against Membership Inference Attacks while maintaining utility when plugged into other privacy approaches.

papers.title: MINIM: Privacy-Aware Minimal View for Agents via Trusted Local Sanitization
papers.contribution: Substantially reduces task-irrelevant sensitive leakage while preserving task-critical semantic context and interactive affordances required for reliable agent actions.

papers.title: MOAI: Module-Optimizing Architecture for Non-Interactive Secure Transformer Inference
papers.contribution: The framework achieves 52.8% reduction in evaluation time compared to THOR on BERT-base inference.

papers.title: Membership Inference Attacks Against Fine-tuned Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: SAMA achieves 30% relative AUC improvement over baselines with up to 8x improvement at low false positive rates.

papers.title: Membership Inference Attacks for Unseen Classes
papers.contribution: Quantile regression attacks achieve up to 11× the TPR of shadow model-based approaches, providing theoretical analysis of required generalization properties.

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Mixtures of Gaussians in Approximate Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: Achieves substantially lower expected noise amplitudes (l1-loss) and variances (l2-loss) compared to analytic Gaussian mechanism, approaching optimality in low-privacy regime.

papers.title: No Caption, No Problem: Caption-Free Membership Inference via Model-Fitted Embeddings
papers.contribution: MoFit consistently outperforms VLM-conditioned baselines across datasets and diffusion models, enabling caption-free privacy auditing when annotations are unavailable.

papers.title: OSNIP: Balancing the Privacy-Utility-Efficiency Trilemma in LLM Inference via Obfuscated Semantic Null Space
papers.contribution: Achieve state-of-the-art privacy-utility performance with near-orthogonality to original embeddings while reducing attack success rates.

papers.title: On the trade-off between expressivity and privacy in graph representation learning
papers.contribution: Embeddings match expected expressive power of message-passing and subgraph GNNs while providing formal differential privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Operationalizing Data Minimization for Privacy-Preserving LLM Prompting
papers.contribution: Larger frontier LLMs tolerate stronger data minimization than smaller models (85.7% redaction for GPT-5 vs 19.3% for Qwen2.5-0.5B) while maintaining task quality.

papers.title: OptiFluence: Principled Design of Privacy Canaries
papers.contribution: Achieves 99.6% true positive rate at 0.1% false positive rate on CIFAR-10 with optimized canaries that transfer effectively across architectures without retraining.

papers.title: Optimizing Canaries for Privacy Auditing with Metagradient Descent
papers.contribution: Optimized canaries improve empirical lower bounds for differentially private image classification models by over 2× in certain instances, with transferability to larger models trained with DP-SGD.

papers.title: PE-SGD: Differentially Private Deep Learning via Evolution of Gradient Subspace for Text
papers.contribution: Outperforms DP-SGD and baselines especially in limited private data and small privacy budget regimes.

papers.title: PEARL: Differentially Private and Entropy-Aware Regulated Language Generation
papers.contribution: PEARL preserves privacy while reducing hallucination (whereas DP alone increases hallucination), improving both trustworthiness and robustness against PII extraction.

papers.title: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA
papers.contribution: Maintains standard (ε,δ)-DP guarantees with stable privacy-utility trade-offs via bounded gauge-invariant perturbations.

papers.title: Persuasive Privacy
papers.contribution: Shows pure and probabilistic differential privacy are special cases; provides new interpretations of post-processing inequality and enables deterministic algorithm privacy.

papers.title: PetaGAIL++: Utility Optimized Private Trajectory Generation with Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Significantly improves trajectory fidelity, downstream task performance, and scalability under strong differential privacy guarantees compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: Prediction with Expert Advice under Local Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: Outperforms classical baselines and state-of-the-art central DP algorithms by 1.5-3x on COVID-19 hospital prediction tasks.

papers.title: PrivCode++: Latent-Conditioned Differentially Private Code Generation for Comprehensive Guarantees
papers.contribution: First work on DP code generation protecting both prompts and code, achieving substantially higher utility than baselines with stronger privacy guarantees.

papers.title: PrivGate: Steering Contextual Integrity in LLMs via Latent Space Geometry
papers.contribution: Achieves 62.6% average relative reduction in privacy leakage with 15.9% token overhead while maintaining high performance in out-of-distribution risk identification.

papers.title: Privacy Amplification in Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Optimization with Hidden States
papers.contribution: Establishes convergent DP bound for zeroth-order optimization and induces better privacy-aware zeroth-order algorithmic designs.

papers.title: Privacy Beyond Pixels: Latent Anonymization for Privacy-Preserving Video Understanding
papers.contribution: Achieves 35% reduction in privacy leakage while maintaining near-baseline utility across Action Recognition, Temporal Action Detection, and Anomaly Detection tasks.

papers.title: Privacy-Aware Video Anomaly Detection through Orthogonal Subspace Projection
papers.contribution: Embedding privacy constraints into model design reduces sensitive information while maintaining or improving detection accuracy.

papers.title: Private Learning with Public Feature Conditioning
papers.contribution: Faster convergence than standard DPSGD in private linear regression without additional privacy cost, with consistent improvements across datasets.

papers.title: Private Rate-Constrained Optimization with Applications to Fair Learning
papers.contribution: Novel SGDA analysis leveraging dual parameter linearity achieves convergence while Pareto-dominating existing private learning under group fairness constraints.

papers.title: Private and Stable Test-time Adaptation with Differential Privacy
papers.contribution: Provides adequate privacy at small accuracy cost on ImageNet-C, where low-privacy regimes even improve accuracy and stability of continual adaptation.

papers.title: Privately Fine-Tuned LLMs Preserve Temporal Dynamics in Tabular Data
papers.contribution: Reduces distributional distance to real trajectories by over 60% and state transition errors by 50% compared to marginal-based mechanisms.

papers.title: Protection against Source Inference Attacks in Federated Learning
papers.contribution: The method reduces attack accuracy to random guessing levels without affecting model accuracy and integrates seamlessly with other privacy mechanisms.

papers.title: Provably Protecting Fine-Tuned LLMs from Training Data Extraction while Preserving Utility
papers.contribution: Orders-of-magnitude better theoretical bounds than existing NAF methods, with strong empirical protection against TDE attacks and minimal performance loss.

papers.title: Reconstructing Template-Memorized Images from Natural Prompts
papers.contribution: Shows unintentional reconstruction is possible by naive users with simple prompts like 'blue Unisex T-Shirt', revealing novel TMI phenomena and questions about generated content novelty.

papers.title: Rethinking Pretraining Data Detection for LLMs: From Local to Global
papers.contribution: AECA surpasses previous methods by up to 1.5% in average AUC on WikiMIA benchmark with advantages particularly pronounced in long-text scenarios.

papers.title: Revisiting ML Training under Fully Homomorphic Encryption: Convergence Guarantees, Differential Privacy, and Efficient Algorithms
papers.contribution: The work advances feasibility of efficient, private, and secure machine learning on sensitive data with proven convergence guarantees.

papers.title: SMOTE and Mirrors: Exposing Privacy Leakage from Synthetic Minority Oversampling
papers.contribution: Reveals that SMOTE is inherently non-private with perfect distinction of real vs synthetic records and near-perfect minority record reconstruction under realistic imbalance ratios.

papers.title: SecP-Tuning: Efficient Privacy-Preserving Prompt Tuning for Large Language Models via MPC
papers.contribution: Achieves ~12x and 16x end-to-end acceleration vs full-parameter SFT and gradient-based prompt tuning; 18x and 20x reductions in communication overhead.

papers.title: Secret-Protected Evolution for Differentially Private Synthetic Text Generation
papers.contribution: Across OpenReview, PubMed, and Yelp benchmarks, SecPE achieves lower Fréchet Inception Distance and higher downstream task accuracy than GDP-based baselines while requiring less noise.

papers.title: Secure Inference for Diffusion Models via Unconditional Scores
papers.contribution: Enables more relaxed approximations for secure diffusion inference while preserving semantic and perceptual quality with reduced latency.

papers.title: Shift-Dependent Asymmetry: Orthogonal Inverse Low-Rank Adaptation for Federated Medical Segmentation
papers.contribution: Consistent improvements over federated LoRA and parameter-efficient baselines.

papers.title: Shuffling-Aware Optimization for Private Vector Mean Estimation
papers.contribution: Constructs asymptotically optimal mechanism achieving privacy-utility trade-off nearly identical to central Gaussian mechanism.

papers.title: Skirting Additive Error Lower Bounds for Private Turnstile Streams
papers.contribution: Demonstrates trade-off between multiplicative and additive error in private continual estimation, opening new directions for privacy-utility balance.

papers.title: SlaClip: Gradient Norm Slacks can be Indicator for Adaptive Clipping in DP-SGD
papers.contribution: Achieves privacy-preserving adaptive clipping as plug-and-play module for vanilla DP-SGD with consistent performance improvements across diverse tasks.

papers.title: Stop Tracking Me! Proactive Defense Against Attribute Inference Attack in LLMs
papers.contribution: TRACE-RPS reduces attribute inference accuracy from around 50% to below 5% across diverse LLMs with strong cross-model generalization.

papers.title: The Hidden Risk: Membership Inference Attacks on Multimodal Federated Learning via Modality Imbalance
papers.contribution: Proposes modality-aware MIA approach that outperforms baselines by adaptively selecting attack modalities and calibrating inference results.

papers.title: Unified Privacy Guarantees for Decentralized Learning via Matrix Factorization
papers.contribution: Achieves tighter privacy accounting than existing methods with MAFALDA-SGD outperforming prior approaches on synthetic and real-world graphs.

papers.title: Unlearning with Asymmetric Sources: Improved Unlearning-Utility Trade-off with Public Data
papers.contribution: Achieves strict computational advantage over retraining while maintaining utility under reasonable distribution shifts through public data injection.

papers.title: Where Rectified Flows Leak: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
papers.contribution: Shows bell-shaped membership signal structure is universal with peak location derivable in closed form under Gaussian assumptions, enabling membership inference attack exploiting λ-resolved structure.
